requirements.text: Students should be able to search the library catalogue and see real-time availability for books and materials.
Students should have the option to place a hold on checked-out items.
The borrowing process should allow students to borrow books online without needing to physically come to the library.
Students should receive notifications about their loan status, including due dates.
Students should be able to view their current loans, due dates, and renew items if they haven't been requested by others.
Automated email reminders before due dates are essential.
Students should be able to view available study rooms and their capacities online.
Students should have the flexibility to select the date and time they want to book study rooms.
Staff should have a user-friendly interface to add new items, update existing information, and retire outdated materials.
The system should track inventory levels in real-time, reflecting checked-out statuses and the availability of multiple copies.
The system needs robust reporting capabilities to generate insights on loan volumes, room utilisation metrics, and revenue from overdue fines.
Staff should be able to set restrictions on student accounts with outstanding fines above a certain threshold.
The system should automatically calculate overdue fines based on a configurable daily rate for overdue items.
Students should have visibility into their fines, current loans, and due dates in their account.
If a student's fines exceed a certain threshold, the system should automatically block them from borrowing new items or booking study rooms until the fines are cleared.
The system should send automated email reminders to students a few days before their due dates and notify them of any fines applied.
The system must comply with GDPR for customer data storage, including borrowing history and fines.
The new system must seamlessly integrate with the current student record system to verify student enrolment statuses for loans and room bookings.
Budget constraints must be considered for both initial setup and ongoing maintenance costs.
The system must be accessible via Single Sign-On (SSO), mobile-friendly, and adhere to accessibility standards.
There must be a plan in place to successfully migrate existing loan and student account data from the legacy system to the new system.
